verdicts.originalText: Authored at the Cryo absorption branch only (+20% CR for 20s). Up to 2 elemental branches activate per cast based on what Wanderer's skill contacts at unleash — Hydro raises Kuugoryoku cap (resource not modelled), Pyro grants +30% ATK 20s, Electro grants N/CA energy regen 20s. Planner can't predict which elements absorb, so this is a manual-trigger window — toggle on when the canonical comp absorbs Cryo.
verdicts.proposedText: Only the Cryo branch's +20% CR (20s) is modeled, as a manual toggle you enable when the comp absorbs Cryo. Not modeled: Pyro's +30% ATK, Electro's N/CA energy regen, Hydro's resource cap.
verdicts.rationale: Rewrite: original is ~400ch with the banned 'modelled' spelling, names Wanderer (shown by the panel), uses the discouraged 'Planner can't' voice, and explains kit mechanics. Compressed to the two user-facing facts — the Cryo branch's +20% CR is the one authored effect and is a manual toggle, and the other absorption branches are not modeled. Multi-element absorption is on the CANNOT list (out of scope by constitution), so this manual-trigger note is a legitimate divergence, not implementDelete; the wave-3 'authored manual trigger = toggle it on' phrasing applies. All claims trace to the original caveat.
demotedNotes: Caveat trimmed for length: the non-Cryo absorption branches each last 20s (Pyro +30% ATK, Electro N/CA energy regen); up to 2 of 4 elemental branches absorb per skill cast and the tool can't predict which elements are contacted, which is why the Cryo branch is authored as a manual toggle. (Already captured in the stub-with-caveat note above.)
